character.description: chibi young hunter for a cozy Korean BBQ restaurant game: spiky black hair, red bandana, green hooded jacket, cream apron, brown gloves and boots, a harpoon with a coiled rope slung on the back, a small cleaver at the belt; comic cute pixel art, dark outline, quarter-view top-down RPG camera

chroma_key.name: cyan
chroma_key.selection_reason: highest 1st-percentile subject distance among the 4 candidate(s) clearing the 96 erase radius

down_idle.action: standing idle, facing the viewer (front view); subtle breathing; canonical direction anchor derived from the base

down45_idle.action: standing idle, 45-degree three-quarter-front view; subtle breathing; canonical direction anchor derived from the base

side_idle.action: standing idle, pure side profile view facing camera-right; subtle breathing; canonical direction anchor derived from the base

up45_idle.action: standing idle, 45-degree three-quarter-back view; subtle breathing; canonical direction anchor derived from the base

up_idle.action: standing idle, facing away from the viewer (back view, no visible face); subtle breathing; canonical direction anchor derived from the base

down_walk.action: walk cycle toward the viewer (front view): left and right feet clearly alternate stepping forward, arms swing opposite to the legs, harpoon stays slung on the back, small body bob

down45_walk.action: walk cycle on the 45-degree diagonal toward camera-right and slightly toward the viewer (three-quarter-front): left and right feet clearly alternate, arms swing opposite to the legs, harpoon stays slung on the back

side_walk.action: walk cycle to the right (pure side profile): left and right feet clearly alternate with a full stride, arms swing opposite to the legs, harpoon stays slung on the back

up45_walk.action: walk cycle on the 45-degree diagonal away from the viewer toward camera-right (three-quarter-back): left and right feet clearly alternate, arms swing opposite to the legs, harpoon on the back visible

up_walk.action: walk cycle away from the viewer (back view, no face visible): left and right feet clearly alternate, arms swing opposite to the legs, harpoon on the back visible

style: comic, cute, chunky pixel art with a dark outline, same as the base image
